overview: NovelHub is an online novel reading and writing platform where users can read novels, track their progress, follow friends, and — as authors — create and collaboratively write novels with real-time co-editing.
features: Author login and role system via Internet Identity
Author dashboard to create, edit, and delete novels
Chapter creation and editing with rich text editor
Real-time collaborative writing with polling-based live sync
Active co-author presence display in editor
Co-author management with add/remove from novels
Novel library with search, filter, and genre browsing
Top 5 ranked novels by reads and ratings
Friends system and reading activity feed
